posts.cooked: Apologies if this has been answered already, but will people who preordered Wrath of the Cosmos be receiving oversized villain character cards for the Wrath of the Cosmos villains and Wager Master?
posts.raw: Apologies if this has been answered already, but will people who preordered Wrath of the Cosmos be receiving oversized villain character cards for the Wrath of the Cosmos villains and Wager Master?

posts.name: Rabit
posts.cooked:
I believe they've said they're going to just do oversized villain card sets, so the WotC villains and Wager Master will be available in a set GTG will release later with all those others that haven't been provided, yet.

That was my understanding, anyway - could be wrong.

Personally, I think this approach makes the most sense. There were problems with folks getting a couple here and there but not getting all of them, then the only way they could was to buy the later set, resulting in a lot of (perceived) wasted money / cards. This is a much cleaner, easier way of handling it - even if it means I don't get my oversized cards as soon as I want…
